title: Umbingelelo Wamkelwa Ngenceba
intro: Vala amehlo akho uze ube nombono wentlambo enkulu, ethuleyo apho ukholo luvavanywa khona ngokupheleleyo. Uza kudibana nomntu okuzithoba kwakhe okuzolileyo xa ejamelene nomyalelo ongenakulinganiswa kwaguqula umzuzu wovavanyo lwaba luphawu olungunaphakade lokuthobela nenceba kaThixo.
clues: Ndikhunjulwa kwiQuran phakathi kwabo banyamezela ngomonde oqinileyo.
Ndandiphakathi kombono owawuvavanya ukuthobela umyalelo ka-Allah.
Ndathi ndakuxelelwa ngombono, ndathi mandenze njengoko ndiyalelweyo, uza kundifumana ndiphakathi kwesigulana.
Ndandibekwe phantsi ngenxa yedini, kodwa uAllah wabiza ukuba umbono uzaliseke.
U-Allah wandihlawulela ngedini elikhulu, wandishiyela imbeko phakathi kwezizukulwana ezizayo.
NdinguIsmail, owathi kunye no-Ibrahim waphakamisa iziseko zeNdlu eNgcwele, ndakhankanywa kunye no-Idris noDhul-Kifl phakathi kwamalungisa.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Ukubiza abafileyo babuyele ebomini ngemvume ka-Allah

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Ubethwe kukuqhuma okukhulu ngenxa yokwala inkamela eyimazi

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. (21:86)
